arStrings.szText: After Critically Striking an enemy with {c_important}Shred{/c}, you gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} Spirit. While at {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} Spirit, your {c_important}Werewolf{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1%x|]{/c} increased damage until you go below {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} Spirit.

Critically Striking an enemy with {c_important}Shred{/c} gives {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} Spirit. While at {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} Spirit, your {c_important}Werewolf{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1%x|]{/c} increased damage until you go below {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} Spirit.
